# Zenify

> Zenify is a modern, high-performance web and mobile music streaming platform featuring studio Web Audio DSP effects, sub-second multilingual synchronized lyrics, 8D spatial audio, and local file playback.

## Overview
Zenify offers a seamless, ad-free listening experience directly in the web browser with offline PWA support. It integrates synchronized syllable-accurate lyrics for Tamil, Tanglish, Hindi, Malayalam, and English music, a 3-band biquad equalizer, and binaural audio spatialization.

## Core Features
- **Multilingual Synced Lyrics**: Sub-second synchronization with syllable-level timing and automated instrumental gap detection.
- **StudioFX Multi-Band Equalizer**: Right-side glass panel audio processor with high-precision biquad audio filtering, collapsible FX sections, and quick bypass toggles.
- **8D Spatial Audio**: Real-time binaural spatial audio panning engine simulating a 360-degree soundstage.
- **DJ Speed & Pitch Warper**: Live DSP pitch and tempo manipulation for nightcore, daycore, and slowed-and-reverb audio.
- **Local Audio Scanner**: In-browser client-side playback of MP3, FLAC, WAV, and AAC audio files with 100% user privacy.
- **Offline PWA**: Full progressive web app offline caching with lock-screen MediaSession controls.

- [Search Songs & Lyrics](https://listenzenify.vercel.app/search): Global smart search across artists, tracks, and lyric keywords.
- [Zenify Premium Plans](https://listenzenify.vercel.app/pricing): Overview of free and Eclipse high-fidelity audio subscription tiers.
- [About Zenify](https://listenzenify.vercel.app/about-zenify): Architectural principles, open-source mission, and technology overview.
- [Radio](https://listenzenify.vercel.app/radio): Continuous automated music streams and mood-based radio channels.
- [Local Library](https://listenzenify.vercel.app/local-library): Offline device storage music scanner and ID3 tag parser.
- [Privacy Policy](https://listenzenify.vercel.app/privacy): Information regarding telemetry, cookies, and local session security.
- [Terms of Service](https://listenzenify.vercel.app/terms): Terms and conditions governing the use of Zenify.
